Acceptance criteria  
1. All test activities conclude and the full documentation—including the compliance certificate—reaches me no later than Day 7.  
2. Reports are reproducible: any finding must be verifiable on request.  
3. Confidential data gathered during testing is securely deleted and not disclosed.  
4. One complimentary retest of patched items is included if initiated within 30 days.

Environment access and scheduling details will be provided immediately after contract award so you can start without delay.

title: Outdoor Candid Portfolio Photoshoot
desc:
I’m updating my professional portfolio and need a photographer who excels at truly candid, story-driven imagery. The shoot will take place outdoors in a natural landscape—think parks, woodlands, or any scenic backdrop that lets us play with texture, depth, and natural light.  

I’d like to schedule the session in the afternoon when the sun is still bright enough for crisp detail but low enough to add warmth and soft shadows. I’m looking for a relaxed vibe rather than posed shots, so an eye for spontaneous moments is essential. You can work with available light, but if you have reflectors or portable strobes that complement afternoon conditions, feel free to bring them.  

Deliverables  
• 20–25 high-resolution, fully edited images suitable for both print and web  
• A small set of lightly retouched previews within 48 hours so I can start sharing on socials  
• Final gallery delivered via a secure download link within one week of the shoot  

If you have a portfolio that showcases outdoor candid work, please share a link when you respond. I’m happy to discuss location ideas, styling, and any gear requirements once we connect.

title: LinkedIn Email Extraction to Excel
desc:
This is a QUICK project. A couple of hours.


I need a  Excel sheet that captures email addresses taken directly from LinkedIn profiles. Every email must be sourced only from the profile itself—no outside databases or enrichment tools—so the sheet can be traced back to verifiable LinkedIn URLs. Alongside the email, please include the profile link and any standard public details you gather in the scrape (name, current job title, company, location).

title: Excel Data Migration & Merge
desc:
I have several spreadsheets that need to be brought together into one clean, well-structured workbook. Your main focus will be migrating data from multiple sources, merging overlapping tables, and resolving any inconsistencies along the way.  

Here’s what I’m after:  
• Collect each source file, import it into Microsoft Excel (CSV, XLS, or XLSX).

• Remove duplicates, fix obvious entry errors, and flag any anomalies you’re unsure about.  
• Deliver a single master sheet (or an organized set of linked sheets) that can serve as a lightweight database for future reporting.  
• Provide a brief log of the steps you took so I can trace any changes.

I work almost entirely in Excel, so please stick to native functions wherever possible; light VBA is fine if it keeps the file user-friendly. If you’ve handled data migration or consolidation projects before, especially where precision and data integrity are critical, I’d love to see an example.

Turnaround is flexible—but accuracy is not. Let me know how soon you can start and the timeframe you’ll need to complete the merge confidently.

title: Categorized Data Entry Sheet
desc:
I need a straightforward spreadsheet that lets my team capture text-based records and automatically places each entry into its correct category. The layout should be clean and distraction-free, so anyone can open the file and start typing without extra instructions. 

The categories themselves will be fixed, visible at a glance, and ideally colour-tinted or otherwise separated so entries never end up in the wrong spot. Simple drop-down selectors or protected cells that guard headers from accidental edits are welcome, but please keep formulas and formatting lightweight—clarity is more important than bells and whistles.

You may build it in either Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel; just make sure I can copy or download the finished file and use it immediately. If shortcuts or data-validation tools are included, a short note inside the sheet is enough for me to understand how they work.

title: Pan-India Data Collection – Wellness & Panchakarma Centres with Owner Contact Details

title: Legal Case Study Author (AI Training) EU Regulatory Case Study Author
desc:

Set out the scoped deliverable plan and the assu

title: Personalized Lifestyle Fitness Coaching

title: Precise Scanned Doc Transcription
desc:

title: Mitra – Wearable Prototype for Dementia Care

title: CAPS Commerce e-Learning Modules
desc:
I am building a full set of interactive, CAPS-aligned learning modules for Grade 8 to 12 Commerce subjects—Accounting, Economics and Business Studies—designed for delivery on a digital platform or LMS.

Each module must contain the following five components:

• Learning Objectives – clearly stated “by the end of this lesson, learners will…”.  
• Teach – an engaging, step-by-step explanation delivered through illustrative slide decks (no live-action or full animation required).  
• Practice – guided activities and independent exercises that mix Multiple Choice, Fill-in-the-Blank and Short Answer questions, all supplied with worked solutions.  
• Assess – an auto-gradable quiz or test that pinpoints misconceptions and reports scores.  
• Track & Improve – concise progress reports plus targeted revision or support suggestions.

I will supply the CAPS/ATP pacing documents; you turn them into structured content, visually clean slide decks (PowerPoint, Google Slides or similar), and SCORM-ready quizzes where possible. All wording must be original, curriculum-accurate and age-appropriate, and graphics should be licence-free.

Deliverables are the completed slide decks, printable worksheets, answer keys, quiz files and a simple progress-tracking template for each grade and subject.

title: Mentor Privat Dasar Keterampilan Digital
desc:
Saya ingin belajar secara santai namun terstruktur tentang keterampilan digital dasar. Saat ini saya masih pemula total dan belum memutuskan bidang spesifik—programming, desain grafis, atau pemasaran digital semuanya menarik bagi saya. Yang saya perlukan:

• Rekomendasi bidang mana yang paling cocok untuk pemula dan cepat terasa manfaatnya.  
• Rangkaian 3–4 sesi daring (video call atau screen-sharing) berdurasi ±1 jam per sesi.  
• Materi ringkas setiap pertemuan: konsep inti, demonstrasi langsung, serta latihan praktis sederhana.  
• Saran sumber belajar gratis atau murah supaya saya bisa melanjutkan secara mandiri.

Gaya mengajar yang saya harapkan: jelas, sabar, dan memakai contoh nyata. Silakan jelaskan pendekatan Anda, topik yang akan dibahas di tiap sesi, serta tools apa yang akan kita gunakan (misalnya VS Code, Canva, Google Ads—sesuai bidang yang Anda usulkan).

title: Berry Crop Cultivation Blueprint
desc:
I am gearing up to launch a dedicated strawberry and blueberry operation and need a clear, science-backed roadmap that takes me from field preparation through to first harvest. Your job is to translate best-practice horticulture into a practical plan I can follow on the ground.

To be useful, the blueprint should cover:
• Recommended cultivars matched to temperate climates and the soil profile I will share with you  
• Detailed bed layout, spacing, and mulching strategy  
• A season-long irrigation and fertigation schedule with product rates and timing  
• Preventive and corrective pest- and disease-management protocols that align with integrated pest management principles  
• Harvest timing, post-harvest handling, and basic yield projections so I can model cash flow  

Please organise the material so I can act on it immediately—tables, calendars, and step-by-step instructions are welcome where they add clarity. I will consider the project complete when I receive an editable document (Word or Google Docs) plus any supporting spreadsheets that let me adjust inputs as my acreage or budget changes.

title: Lecture Notes PDF Transcription
desc:
I have a small bundle of handwritten lecture notes—no more than ten pages—that I need turned into a clean, searchable PDF. You will receive high-resolution scans of the original paper notes, and I want the digital version to mirror the layout, headings, and spacing exactly as they appear on the page. Any equations, sketches, or marginal annotations should be reproduced faithfully.

Once the content is typed and formatted to match the source, export it to PDF and double-check that every page aligns with the original. Please include an editable copy (Word or Google Docs) alongside the final PDF so I can make minor adjustments later if needed.

Accuracy and quick turnaround are my priorities; let me know your estimated timeline and any relevant sample work when you respond.

title: Engaging Product Catalogue Design
desc:

Requirements:

- Strong graphic design and typography skills.
- Attention to detail and a keen eye for aesthetics.

Please provide samples of previous work.

title: Expansion Joint FEA Analysis
desc:
I need a full finite-element simulation of an aluminium expansion joint cover carried out in Autodesk Inventor. My main objective is to see how stresses are distributed through the part once the service loads and boundary supports are applied.

I will send you the Inventor 3D model together with load cases and constraints. You will set up the study, solve it, and return both the working Inventor files (.ipt/.iam plus the .results set-up) and a short, illustrated PDF that walks through material definition, mesh strategy, boundary conditions, and the final von Mises stress plots. Highlight any hot spots, quote max/min values, and include brief design-improvement notes if the results suggest them.

Acceptance criteria:  
• Mesh-convergence check included and documented  
• Critical stress values and their exact locations clearly marked  
• Files open and re-solve successfully in Inventor 2022+ on my end  
• PDF report matches the in-software results without discrepancies  

If everything aligns, the job is complete and we can move straight to sign-off.

title: Panduan Fashion Gen Z Casual
desc:
Saya ingin mendapat panduan lengkap untuk memadukan warna dan potongan atasan casual—khususnya crop top—agar tampil khas Gen Z. Ruang lingkup yang saya butuhkan meliputi:

• Contoh padu padan crop top dengan bawahan populer (jeans, cargo, atau rok mini) beserta alas kaki dan aksesori opsional.  
• Saran bahan kain serta detail grafis atau pola yang cocok dengan gaya street-casual.  
• Visual mood-board sederhana (bisa berupa kolase Canva/PowerPoint) untuk membantu membayangkan keseluruhan look.  

Format akhir cukup dalam satu dokumen PDF dengan teks ringkas, gambar referensi, dan tabel warna. Saya mengutamakan solusi praktis yang mudah dibeli atau diproduksi di pasar lokal Indonesia.

title: Handwritten Lectures PDF Transcription
desc:
I have a collection of lecture notes written by hand in both English and Hindi. Your job is to type every word exactly as it appears—no extra formatting or restructuring—then supply the finished text as clean, searchable PDFs.

The page count is open-ended; I may send a small batch first and follow with more if the initial work meets expectations, so please be comfortable handling anything from a dozen sheets to a full notebook. Accuracy matters more than speed: line breaks, spellings, and any shorthand must stay true to the original handwriting in whichever language appears on the page.

Deliverables  
• Word-for-word digital transcription of each page  
• One PDF per lecture set (or per page if that proves easier for you)  
• Original file format used for typing (Word, Google Docs, or similar) in case edits are needed

Acceptance criteria  
• 100 % text captured with no omissions  
• English and Hindi characters rendered correctly (use Unicode fonts)  
• Page order preserved and filenames labelled clearly

If this sounds straightforward to you, let me know your turnaround time for an initial ten pages and we can scale up from there.

title: Verified Corporate Phone Number Sourcing
desc:

Acceptance criteria

• Bounce-back or switchboard numbers will be rejected and need replacement.

Let me know your estimated turnaround time per 100 records and which verification platform you prefer to use.

title: Payday Loan Application Testers Needed
desc:
I’m running a product-testing study for several online payday-loan platforms and need a handful of U.S. citizens to walk through the real application flow, then tell me exactly how long each step takes and when the final decision comes through.  

Here’s how the test works  
1. I’ll send you a link to one designated lender’s site along with a short checklist of the data points to capture (start time, each intermediate screen, final approval or denial time).  
2. You complete the application with your own accurate details up to—but not beyond—the point where funds would be disbursed. No specific financial history is required; you simply need to be comfortable filling out the form truthfully.  
3. While you work, record screen or take clear timestamped screenshots. When finished, write a brief note on anything that slowed you down or felt confusing.  

Deliverables  
• Timestamped screenshots or video of the full flow  
• A one-page summary covering total application time, wait time for decision, and any verification steps requested  

That’s it. No credit will actually be taken out; you can abandon the process before accepting funds. I’ll release payment once I receive the media files and concise report. Feel free to ask any clarifying questions before you start.

title: SuccessFactors EC Workflow Configuration
desc:

Here is what I expect:

• Design the required business rules to trigger the correct workflow, enforce our data standards, and prevent inconsistent entries.  
• Build and activate the approval process, routing it through the right roles and steps (sequential or parallel as best fits each case).  
• Unit-test together with me in the test tenant, then migrate to production once sign-off is achieved.

You will have access to our SF provisioning and test tenants. Please be comfortable working with the latest Employee Central framework, business rule scenarios, MDF objects, and the Workflow V2 engine. title: UK Cosmetics SDS & CPSR Support
desc:

Speed matters—the first batches must be turned around ASAP—but this will roll into an ongoing relationship as new SKUs come on-stream. You will be expected to work from raw formula data, finished-goods specs and supplier SDSs; cross-check each hazard classification; calculate correct signal words, H-statements and precautionary statements; and return fully formatted, compliant PDFs plus editable originals.

I’ll grant fast access to all PIFs, supplier documents and previous versions. Please outline your experience with UK cosmetics compliance, CLP labelling and SDS authoring software when you respond.

4. For packaged ingredients such as spice mixes, stock cubes, tomato paste or canned items, also photograph the front and back of the package.
5. Plate one serving and take one clear photo plus a 3 to 5 second video moving slowly around the p

If this matches your skill set and you have a knack for turning dense material into concis

desc:

• Your rate per recorded minute or per 1,000 words

I will review samples for spelling, consistency and overall presentation before awarding the project. Thank you!

title: Solar Drawings BoM Preparation
desc:
I need a qualified electrical or mechanical engineer who can read my rooftop-solar project drawings and turn them into a procurement-ready Bill of Material. The BoM should cover only the mounting structure and the electrical wiring—solar panels are outside this scope.

For the mounting structure, note the exact material type and all relevant dimensions so a fabricator can quote without extra questions.  
For the wiring schedule, include the wire gauge, insulation type, and conduction material for every cable run, separating DC string, AC output, and earthing conductors when they differ.

Deliverables  
• Editable spreadsheet (Excel or Google Sheets) listing item codes, descriptions, quantities and units, with the above details clearly captured.  
• Short annotation PDF that cross-references each BoM line to the drawing numbers.  
• One revision round to resolve any queries.

I’ll provide the DWG and PDF drawings on award; you may work in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, ETAP or similar, provided the final documents arrive in the requested formats. Let me know your experience preparing solar procurement packages and your expected turnaround time.

title: Penulis Konten Media Sosial Dibutuhkan
desc:
Saya sedang membuka peluang freelancing bagi penulis yang terbiasa membuat konten menarik khusus untuk platform media sosial. Fokusnya adalah merancang teks yang singkat, padat, dan memicu interaksi—dari caption Instagram hingga thread informatif di Twitter.

Lingkup tugas:
• Menyusun ide dan kalender konten mingguan.  
• Menulis 5–7 posting asli per minggu (caption, headline, atau thread pendek).  
• Menyesuaikan gaya bahasa dengan target audiens serta identitas merek.  
• Menyertakan riset hashtag dan call-to-action sederhana di tiap posting.

Kriteria keberhasilan:
• Teks mudah dipahami, bebas salah ketik, dan relevan dengan tren terkini.  
• Setiap posting mampu mendorong komentar, like, atau share sesuai tujuan kampanye.  
• File akhir dikirim dalam Google Docs atau format serupa agar mudah direvisi.

Saya terbuka mendengar ide kreatif lain untuk meningkatkan engagement. Sertakan contoh tulisan media sosial terbaik Anda dan sebutkan berapa lama rata-rata Anda butuh menyelesaikan satu batch konten mingguan.

title: YouTube Vlog Editor & Thumbnails
desc:
I publish regular, personality-driven vlogs and now need a skilled video editor who can turn my raw footage into a smooth, engaging story – no jump-cut frenzy, just clean pacing that feels natural to watch. Each episode should flow effortlessly, carry clear, well-timed subtitles or captions, and feature light background music that complements the mood without overpowering dialogue.

Alongside the edit, I also want an eye-catching YouTube thumbnail that matches the video’s tone and branding.  

Deliverables for every vlog:  
• Fully edited 8–15 min video in 1080p (or higher) with colour correction, audio balancing, and seamless transitions  
• Embedded subtitles/captions (SRT file supplied as well)  
• Royalty-free background music mixed to the correct loudness standard  
• Custom thumbnail (PSD + exported JPG/PNG) that is scroll-stopping yet on-brand  

I typically shoot on a mirrorless camera with external mic and supply all assets via Google Drive. Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve are fine as long as the result meets the criteria above. Consistency and quick turnaround matter to me because new vlog episodes drop weekly.

If this sounds like your wheelhouse, let’s start with a test video and build a long-term workflow together.

title: Ground plus 1 floor - Commercial Facade Detailing & BOQ
desc:
This is a commercial build, and I need complete exterior-facade documentation so construction can move directly from paper to site without guesswork.

title: Telegram 同行频道 广告投放
desc:
我急需一位熟悉 Telegram 生态的广告投放伙伴，帮我把产品广告精准插入到与我行业高度相关的频道里，从而迅速带来销量转化。  

目前我的核心诉求只有一个——在同行频道中高效、合规地投放广告位。只要能直接触达目标用户、促进下单，你采用官方频道置顶、合作软文，还是 banner 贴片，我都愿意尝试并配合。若你还能顺带操作 Telegram Ads 或利用全局搜索做补充曝光，也非常欢迎提出方案，但眼下的重点仍是“同行频道广告”。

• 与频道主谈妥刊登形式、时长与价格并提供截图或聊天记录佐证

• 根据数据给出下一步优化建议，帮助我持续提升 ROI  

时间非常紧，我希望 ASAP 就能启动；如果你有现成的资源库或成熟渠道，将是最大加分项。请直接说明你以往在 Telegram 做过的类似案例、可调用的渠道数，以及大致的执行流程。我会快速评估并确认合作。谢谢！

title: Modern Plans & Magazine Design
desc:
I already have council-approved drawings in DWG format and want them translated into clean, modern-style presentation material. First, I need precise 2D floor plans and matching isometric views generated directly from the CAD files. Line weights, annotations and any colour coding should echo a contemporary, sales-ready aesthetic so the material can move straight into marketing without further touch-ups.

Once the drawings are done, the same look and feel carries into a coffee-table magazine that introduces the development. The publication must weave together the finished floor plans, the architect’s vision and narrative, a concise “about the project” section, plus highlights of surrounding amenities, all laid out in an eye-catching, easy-to-skim format. Expect to handle image curation, typography and export to press-ready PDF.

AutoCAD (or compatible) for the graphics and InDesign/Illustrator for the magazine are ideal, but I’m open to equivalent tools as long as the final files are fully editable.

When you apply, show me past work that proves you can deliver both polished architectural drawings and stylish publication design. I’ll shortlist quickly and share the DWGs so we can lock in timelines and milestones.

title: Product Trending Reels & Shop Links
desc:
I need a series of short, eye-catching reels that showcase a wide mix of market products—from the newest gadgets and fashion pieces to must-have home décor accents. Each reel has to feel fresh and “trending” while still flowing naturally in a weekly sequence I can post on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

Key requirements  
• Every reel must include a clear badge icon that signals “Shop Now” without hiding the product.  
• A single tap on the badge should open the matching product page; I want this link to work seamlessly whether the item is on Amazon, a Shopify store, or Etsy.  
• Visual style should stay flexible so I can slot in casual, formal, or sportswear items alongside electronics and décor without the reel looking mismatched.  
• Soundtrack and text overlays should follow current social-media trends, keeping them short enough to avoid copyright flags.  

Deliverables  
1. Five (5) fully edited reels, 15–30 seconds each, in 9:16 format.  
2. Source files (Premiere Pro or Final Cut) plus separate PNG of the “Shop Now” badge.  
3. A quick walkthrough (screen recording or short PDF) showing where to swap links and logos so I can update future reels myself.

I’ll review for: smooth cuts that keep viewer attention in the first three seconds, crystal-clear badge placement, and fully functioning outbound links on each platform. If everything clicks, I’m ready to commission a larger batch straight away.

title: B+G+27 ETABS + SAFE  Design
desc:
A B+G+27-storey residential tower in the Mumbai /MMR region is ready for detailed structural design. The job covers the complete ETABS model, companion SAFE foundation model, and every deflection-, drift- and stability-check needed to obtain a fully optimised, code-compliant solution.

Scope of work  
I already have the architectural GFC drawings; you will translate them into a refined 3-D analysis model, size and detail every member, and iterate until material usage is minimised without compromising performance. All work must strictly follow the relevant Indian Standards (IS) for high-rise concrete structures, including wind and seismic provisions appropriate to the city.

Key expectations  
• Work locally from Mumbai or the wider MMR so that quick in-person clarifications are possible when required.  
• Use only ETABS  for superstructure and SAFE for raft/pile cap design; no alternate software will be accepted.  
• Document assumptions, load combinations, optimization steps and final utilization ratios.  
• Submit full ETABS/SAFE files and a concise calculation report in PDF are required.

Deliverables (hand-over package)  
1. Final ETABS model .EDB AND .E2K with unlocked access  
2. Final SAFE model (.FSD) AND F2K for foundations.   
3. CO ORDINATE WITH DRAFTSMAN FOR GENERATTION structural drawings. 
5. One walk-through meeting to explain the model and answer peer-review queries.

Acceptance is based on peer verification that all lateral drift, storey displacement, stabili

title: ASPEN Plus Process Simulation Help
desc:
I have a process-simulation task that must be carried out in ASPEN Plus. The focus is on steady-state process modelling rather than molecular dynamics or reaction-engineering studies, so deep familiarity with ASPEN’s unit-operation blocks, property methods, convergence tools and report generation is essential.

Here is what I need from you:
• Build or refine the complete ASPEN Plus model based on stream and equipment data I will supply.
• Provide the working .bkp file together with a concise run report highlighting key stream results, energy balances and any design-sensitive parameters you adjusted.
• Include brief written guidance on how you set up the property method, solved recycles and validated the mass- and energy-balance closure, so I can replicate or extend the work later.

I will share feed compositions, equipment specs, and target performance figures after kickoff. Deliverables are accepted once the model converges without warnings, results match the specified targets within ±2 %, and I can open and run the file on my end.

If you are fluent in ASPEN Plus and process-simulation best practices, let’s get started.

title: Promozione Libro con Amazon Ads
Child Choir Christmas Medley Score
desc:
I’m preparing a Christmas program for a young choir and need a clear, beginner-friendly medley that weaves together “Little Drummer Boy” and “What Child Is This.” The flow should feel traditional, shifting back and forth between the two carols and finishing on the final refrain of “Little Drummer Boy.”  

The arrangement has to suit children with limited reading experience, so uncomplicated voice-leading, comfortable ranges, and plenty of unison or two-part (SA) writing will be best. Please score a supportive yet simple piano accompaniment that helps the singers find pitches without overshadowing them. I’d also like the lyrics placed exactly as they are commonly sung so parents can follow along.  

Deliverables  
• Print-ready PDF of the full score (vocal parts + piano)  
• Separate lyric/choral sheet if the layout becomes cramped  
• Source file from your notation software (Finale, Sibelius, Dorico, MuseScore—whichever you use) so future key changes are possible  

If anything in the brief is unclear, let me know before you start; otherwise, I’m happy to approve a short sample of the opening measures as soon as you have them so we’re both confident about style and difficulty.

title: Saisie Word de textes électroniques
desc:
Je recherche une personne minutieuse pour saisir dans Word plusieurs pages de texte simple que je fournis déjà sous format électronique (PDF ou copier-coller).

• Police et styles homogènes, titres hiérarchisés.  
• Zéro faute de frappe ou omission (taux d’exactitude 100 %).

title: Request Court Completed Filing Status
desc:
I need help obtaining the official filing status of my case from the court, specifically confirmation of all completed filings. This is an information-request task rather than a filing or scheduling job.

Scope

• Secure written or certified confirmation (scan, PDF, or clerk’s letter) that lists each filing marked as complete.  
• Provide a brief summary of any instructions the clerk gives for future updates.

Acceptance  
I will consider the task finished when I receive both the court’s written confirmation and your summary of the interaction.

Familiarity with court clerks, records offices, and polite but persistent follow-up will be important.

title: Trace Residential High-Pitch Squeal -- 2
desc:
I need a skilled RF-oriented technician to come on-site to my residential address, sweep the area with a portable spectrum analyzer, and pinpoint whatever is generating a persistent high-frequency, high-pitch squeal.

If you can suggest quick mitigation steps, even better.

Bring your own calibrated portable spectrum analyzer; no software-only solutions will work for this task. Once the source is confirmed I’ll take it from there—just need the expert ears and equipment to get me the facts.

title: Canada-Wide ISP Sales Campaign
desc:
I operate a nationwide internet service provider and want to accelerate growth by partnering with an experienced direct-sales specialist. The focus is simple: secure new online subscriptions from residential users and small businesses anywhere in Canada.

• Weekly performance report (CSV or spreadsheet) that matches CRM data

title: Strategi Penghasilan 10 Juta per Hari
desc:
Saya menargetkan pemasukan bersih Rp10.000.000 setiap hari dan membutuhkan panduan menyeluruh untuk mewujudkannya. Latar belakang saya ada di keuangan dan investasi, dan saya paling tertarik pada perencanaan keuangan pribadi.

Saya menghargai pendekatan berbasis data dengan pertimbangan manajemen risiko yang ketat. Sertakan template spreadsheet atau dashboard sederhana untuk memantau progres harian serta tolok ukur utama. Hasil akhir yang saya harapkan adalah dokumen perencanaan komprehensif dan file pendukung yang siap langsung saya terapkan.

Useful areas: CMC, submissions, post-approval changes, health-authority queries, device regulatory decisions, stability, manufacturing/site changes or regional

title: Email Marketing Revenue Strategy
desc:
I want to build a reliable new stream of income through digital marketing, and I have decided to focus exclusively on email marketing. What I need is a complete, actionable strategy that turns subscribers into buyers and keeps them engaged for the long term.  

Your plan should cover audience segmentation, compelling copy, automated sequences, and the right mix of promotional versus value-driven content. I’m not in a rush, so you’ll have the breathing room to research, test, and refine ideas before we go live; quality and sustainability matter more to me than speed.  

Please outline the specific platforms or tools you recommend—whether that’s Mailchimp, Klaviyo, HubSpot, or another solution—and explain why they suit this project. If analytics dashboards or A/B testing frameworks are part of your approach, all the better.  

Deliverables  
• A step-by-step email marketing blueprint (strategy, schedule, KPIs)  
• Three core automation workflows ready to deploy (welcome, nurture, re-engagement)

• A simple tracking sheet or dashboard so we can measure revenue impact over time  

Once I review your plan, we can set milestones for implementation and optimisation.

title: Remote Executive Assistant to CEO
desc:
I run a fast-moving company and need a sharp, self-directed assistant working entirely online. You’ll be my right hand, stepping in whenever I can’t be two places at once and keeping small details from slipping through the cracks.  

Success here hinges on three core strengths:  
• Strong communication skills – you’ll relay information clearly, anticipate questions, and adjust tone for board members, partners, or internal teams.  
• Solid project-management instincts – you’re comfortable setting priorities, creating simple trackers, and nudging tasks forward without being asked.  
• Meticulous attention to detail – whether proofreading a memo or double-checking a meeting link, you take pride in flawless execution.  

Day-to-day work will flex with my calendar, but you can expect a steady rhythm of coordinating priorities, drafting quick updates, and following up on open items. Everything happens digitally, so reliable connectivity and proficiency with common cloud tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, basic spreadsheets) are assumed.  

I measure results in peace of mind: by the end of each week I should see a concise status summary outlining what moved, what’s pending, and anything you need from me. If that sounds like your style, tell me how you’ve kept other leaders organized and what systems you rely on to stay one step ahead.

title: Corrección de Contenido Web
desc:
Necesito revisar y pulir los textos de varias páginas web. El trabajo consiste exclusivamente en edición de contenido: quiero que cada párrafo fluya de forma natural, sin errores gramaticales y con un estilo claro y consistente.  

Objetivos específicos:  
• Mejorar la gramática, la ortografía y la puntuación.  
• Ajustar el tono para que sea profesional y coherente con la marca.  
• Garantizar que la lectura sea ágil y atractiva para el usuario.  

Entregables esperados:  
– Documento con las versiones corregidas (marcando cambios y versión limpia).  
– Breve nota con las principales recomendaciones de estilo aplicadas.  

El contenido ya está escrito; lo que busco es una edición cuidadosa, no redacción desde cero. Si tienes experiencia editando páginas web y dominas las buenas prácticas de escritura en español, me encantará colaborar contigo.

title: PPC Campaign to Boost Traffic
desc:
I need an experienced digital marketer who can drive a noticeable surge in web traffic through a well-structured pay-per-click strategy. My priority is measurable growth: more qualified visitors landing on my pages and clear data that shows how each ad performs.

You’ll start by auditing any existing accounts, researching high-intent keywords, and mapping out a funnel-friendly campaign structure. From there, set up and launch ads—primarily on Google Ads, but I’m open to additional platforms if you can justify the value. Continuous optimisation, A/B testing of copy and creatives, and tight budget management are essential. Clear, weekly reports must outline spend, clicks, conversions, and next steps so we stay aligned on performance goals.

Deliverables:
• Initial account audit and keyword research report  
• Live PPC campaigns with conversion tracking correctly configured  
• Ongoing optimisation and split-testing plan  
• Weekly performance summaries with actionable insights  

If you’ve run successful traffic-focused PPC campaigns before and are confident you can replicate that success here, let’s talk specifics and timelines.

title: Landing Page Pengumpul Prospek
desc:
Saya sedang menyiapkan kampanye pemasaran digital yang fokus sepenuhnya pada pengumpulan prospek. Targetnya sederhana: membuat sebuah landing page/web yang menarik, memikat, dan teroptimasi sehingga pengunjung mau meninggalkan data kontak mereka.

Apa yang saya butuhkan:
• Konsep dan rancangan landing page lengkap—dari copywriting persuasif, tata letak visual, hingga elemen call-to-action yang jelas.  
• Integrasi formulir prospek yang langsung tersambung ke sistem email atau spreadsheet pilihan saya.  
• Optimalisasi SEO on-page dasar serta setup tracking (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, atau alat sejenis) agar kinerja halaman dapat saya pantau.  
• Saran headline, gambar, dan struktur konten yang mampu meningkatkan konversi.  

Saya terbuka menggunakan platform apa pun—WordPress, Webflow, atau pembuat landing page spesifik—selama hasil akhirnya mudah saya kelola tanpa bantuan developer setiap kali ingin mengubah teks atau gambar.

Harap sertakan:
• Portofolio landing page sejenis yang pernah Anda kerjakan.  
• Perkiraan durasi pengerjaan.  
• Metode yang akan Anda pakai untuk memastikan tingkat konversi tinggi (misalnya A/B testing atau copywriting framework tertentu).

Saya ingin mulai sesegera mungkin dan siap berdiskusi lebih lanjut mengenai detail teknis maupun referensi desain yang saya sukai.

title: Tech Support & Data Entry Assistance
desc:
I manage a growing technology company and need dependable help keeping our customer touchpoints running smoothly. Day-to-day work centres on three fronts:

1. Multichannel customer support  
   • Answer inbound phone calls, live-chat questions, and email inquiries  
   • Follow our knowledge-base and escalation paths so every issue is logged, resolved, and closed politely  
   • Maintain clear, timestamped notes in our CRM for each interaction

2. Email & chat handling  
   • Monitor shared inboxes, tag or forward messages when escalation is needed, and achieve “inbox zero” by end of shift  
   • Draft concise, error-free replies that reflect our friendly, professional tone

3. Data entry  
   • Update customer records, order details, and support tickets with 100 % accuracy  
   • Perform light web research when additional information is required

I value proactive communication, accuracy, and on-time delivery. Experience in phone, live chat, and email support within a technology environment will help you hit the ground running; familiarity with common CRMs, help-desk tools, and spreadsheets is a plus.

If you can commit to consistent availability, quick response times, and meticulous record-keeping, I’d love to see how you can contribute to our customer experience.

title: Google Ads Competitor Spend Analysis
desc:

title: Expert Needed: Recover Missing Encryption Keys from Overwritten iPhone Backup
desc:
## Title
**Expert Needed: Recover Missing Encryption Keys from Overwritten iPhone Backup**

## Project Description

I need a specialist in iOS backup internals, cryptography, and digital forensics to recover data from an overwritten encrypted iTunes backup.

**Technical situation**
- Device: iPhone 14 Pro
- Original encrypted backup: 18 June 2026
- Later unencrypted backup overwrote the original metadata: 25 June 2026
- Original backup password is available.
- Many original hash-named payload files appear to survive on the SSD.
- Original per-file encryption-key records and associated metadata are missing.

**Required outcome**

Recover the original encryption metadata and per-file keys, then decrypt at least one surviving original payload as proof of feasibility. Reconstructing a file index alone or extracting unrelated files will not meet the objective.

**Who should apply**

Only specialists with hands-on experience in Apple backup encryption, BackupKeyBag, Manifest.db/Manifest.plist, cryptographic key recovery, or forensic recovery of overwritten database records.

**When applying, explain briefly:**
1. Your specific technical approach to this case.
2. Relevant prior experience with Apple encrypted backups or key recovery.
3. The first verification step you would perform to establish whether the original keys remain recoverable.

Generic data-recovery proposals without a case-specific technical approach will not be considered.

title: Industrial Acoustic Survey & Modeling
desc:

• Practical mitigation recommendations ranked by expected dB reduction and implementation effort

The OCR system should identify and extract the following information wherever available on the invoice:

- Supplier name
- Supplier GSTIN
- Supplier invoice number
- Invoice date
- Purchase order number, if available
- Item names
- Item codes or barcodes, if available
- HSN codes
- Quantity
- Unit of measurement
- Purchase rate
- Discount
- Taxable amount
- GST percentage and GS

title: Accurate Handwritten Data Digitization
desc:

title: 320 km Pipeline Waterhammer Study
desc:
I need a complete water-hammer (surge) analysis for a 320 km steel pipeline that transports oil through three pumping stations. The internal diameter is below 500 mm, so pressure waves will travel fast and could overstress the line if pumps trip or valves close unexpectedly.

Scope of work
• Build a transient model in AFT Impulse, Bentley HAMMER, or a comparable tool that handles oil properties accurately.  
• Include the full elevation profile, pipe roughness for steel, pump and valve characteristics, and all three stations.  
• Simulate critical cases such as pump trip, power failure, controlled and emergency valve operations, and start-up/shutdown.  
• Identify maximum and minimum surge pressures and verify they stay within allowable limits for a steel pipe of this size.  
• Size and locate surge-protection devices—relief valves, air vessels, non-slam check valves, or other viable options—and propose operational procedures that minimise transients.

Deliverables
1. Editable model files and any calculation spreadsheets.  
2. A concise design report with assumptions, scenarios, pressure/flow plots, and recommended protection equipment specifications.  
3. A summary sheet I can share with stakeholders outlining key findings and required hardware.

I will supply detailed alignment sheets, pump curves, valve data, and fluid properties once the project begins.

When you reply, please mention similar long-distance oil or water projects you have analysed, the software you prefer,

title: Digital Marketing + Social media and app-install ads manager for a Tamil family app (Tamil + English)

title: Coach House Safety Report
desc:
I am converting a former coach house into a single-family dwelling. The fabric of the building will remain as it is—no walls removed, no roof alterations, no extensions—so the focus is squarely on an interior redesign. Before works can continue, Building Control has asked me for a full safety compliance report covering all applicable regulations for a change-of-use project.

Here is what I need from you:

• A thorough inspection (on-site or via detailed drawings and photos, whichever you can work with) of the existing structure, detailing how it meets or can be made to meet current Building Regulations, especially Parts A, B, E, F and K.  
• Clear recommendations for fire safety measures, means of escape, ventilation, insulation, and any required upgrades to plumbing and electrical layouts that arise from the interior redesign.  
• A professionally formatted Safety Compliance Report ready to submit to Building Control, with references to the relevant clauses, diagrams (AutoCAD/PDF), and a concise executive summary they can sign off.

Acceptance criteria: the report must be accepted by Building Control with no major amendments. If minor clarifications are needed, you’ll update the document promptly.

If you have previous UK change-of-use experience and can turn this around quickly, I’d love to hear how soon you can start and what information you need from me first.

title: Fine Art Nude Vector Illustration
desc:
I’d like to commission a tasteful, full-length nude rendered entirely in vector. The piece should feel grounded in the discipline of classical figure studies, yet look unmistakably like modern vector art: clean paths, precise curves and flat or gently-graded colour fields that remain razor-sharp at any size.

Mood and lighting need to be dramatic and intense—think bold chiaroscuro, deep shadows and powerful highlights that give the subject real weight and presence. I’m after a faithful, realistic portrayal of the human form with no additional symbols or abstract overlays: the anatomical accuracy, posture and atmosphere should do all the storytelling.

Please create the artwork in Adobe Illustrator (or an equivalent app that exports layered .AI and .SVG). Aim for an elegant, restrained palette that still feels rich and painterly when viewed up close.

Deliverables
• Layered .AI with clearly named groups  
• Clean .SVG for infinite scaling  
• High-res PNG/JPEG for quick preview

Acceptance criteria
• All strokes, shapes and gradients stay perfectly crisp at 400% zoom  
• Anatomy is proportionate and believable  
• Lighting supports the dramatic tone without any raster textures  

If this challenge speaks to you, send over a few samples of realistic vector figure work so I can gauge fit.

title: TPR English Games Curriculum
desc:
I am designing a short-cycle English programme for 3- to 5-year-olds that relies entirely on Total Physical Response, gamified play, and plenty of movement. The very first objective is crystal-clear: children must learn to understand simple instructions given in English while they are jumping, clapping, running, or otherwise on the move.  

To make that happen I need a set of lively micro-lessons that can flow seamlessly between an indoor classroom and an outdoor play area. Each session should last no longer than 12–15 minutes, stay high-energy from start to finish, and weave English into actions rather than explanations. Think “Touch your toes!”, “Run to the red cone!”, “Clap twice!”—commands that feel like a game yet build listening comprehension.  

Please base every activity on action games (jump, clap, run, hop, spin), folding songs, chants, and role-play in only when they reinforce those core movements. The language must stay limited to everyday verbs, body parts, colours, and classroom objects so children can succeed without memorising vocabulary lists.  

Deliverables  
• Ten themed lesson plans (PDF + editable file) sequenced for progressive skill-building  
• A one-page teacher cheat sheet per lesson with gestures, target phrases, and timing breaks  
• Printable visual aids or prop suggestions that match the games (e.g., colour cards, footprint mats)  
• Quick-reference assessment checklist that shows how to spot comprehension through action

Scope  
• Set up material cards for both the ceramic (e.g., *MAT_JH-2 or similar) and the composite backing (*MAT_COMPOSITE_DAMAGE or an equivalent strain-rate sensitive option).  
• Apply a projectile model, contact, and realistic boundary conditions.  
• Run multiple speeds across the ballistic range and extract:  
 – Depth of penetration  
 – Cracking and fragmentation pattern  
 – Back-face deformation  
• Post-process in LS-PrePost with plots, animations, and a concise technical note that explains the key trends.  

Deliverables  
1. Keyword files for every speed case, ready to rerun.  
2. All result d3plots and ASCII output relevant to the three damage metrics.  
3. A brief report (PDF or Word) tying the observations to impact velocity, supported by screenshots or contour plots.  

Acceptance criteria  
• The three damage metrics are clearly quantified for each speed.  
• No fatal errors or unstable hourglass energy (>5 %) in any run.  
• Results reproduce when I re-launch them on my own LS-DYNA licence.

desc:
I’m taking a new pontoon houseboat from idea to fabrication and I need a certified Naval Architect who can hand me everything the yard will ask for.  

The scope is a fully detailed set of drawings and a parametric 3D model built in SolidWorks or other competent software. I want both the interior and exterior worked out, right down to bulkheads, furniture modules, deck fittings and window openings. The pontoons will be moulded HDPE while the super-structure is planned in either WPVC panels or aluminium—please allow for both options in the model so we can compare weight and stability.

Deliverables  
• Editable SolidWorks 3D model with organised feature tree  
• Complete 2D drawing package (GA, structural framing, systems routing, key sections and elevations) ready for class or flag submission  
• High-resolution renders that clearly convey interior and exterior finishes  
• PDF/ DWG exports for quick review  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Hydrostatic report shows adequate stability for the chosen materials and loading.  
2. All parts and assemblies open error-free in the current SolidWorks release.  
3. Dimensions and weights in the 2D sheets match the model within accepted tolerances.  

If you’ve produced houseboats or similar floating structures before, I’d love to see examples. Let me know your estimated timeline for the first review set and how you usually structure milestones for a job of this size.

title: Write Beginner Budgeting Guide
desc:

What I need from you is a well-structured, jargon-free explainer that:

• Introduces the core idea of tracking income versus expenses in plain language  
• Walks through setting realistic spending categories, including fixed bills, variable costs, and savings goals  
• Provides a step-by-step example of building a first budget (use easy numbers so beginners can follow the math)  
• Highlights quick wins—small changes that instantly free up cash for an emergency fund  
• Offers practical tips to keep the budget on track month after month, addressing common hurdles like impulse purchases or irregular income

I’d like the tone friendly and motivating, not preachy. Real-world anecdotes, simple tables, or illustrative screenshots of a budget template in Excel or Google Sheets are welcome if they add clarity.

Deliverable: one polished article ready for web publication (Google Doc or Word) with any visuals embedded or attached separately.

If you have experience writing personal-finance content for first-time budgeters, I’m eager to see a brief sample of your work when you bid.

title: Python + Excel VBA developer to complete and test a near-finished Excel add-in (xlwings)
desc:
We have a near-complete Windows desktop application for accountants: a Python engine running behind Excel through xlwings, with an existing Excel front-end, custom ribbon and VBA add-in (.xlam). The core build installs cleanly and is in user acceptance testing. We need an experienced developer to take it over, finish it, and test it properly before every delivery.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
1. Fix UAT defects reported by the end users (report pagination and print layout, Excel window focus, a licence check, and making report templates fully editable, including formulas and rows).
2. Build two features:
   - Auto-update: check a Google Drive location for a new release, download, verify, install, roll back on failure.
   - AI-assisted classification: two ribbon buttons that suggest account classifications from a reference table using an AI API (DeepSeek), behind a swappable provider interface.
3. Test every build yourself on desktop Excel before delivery, including with Chinese (Traditional, Hong Kong) regional settings, and provide a short screen recording of the test run.
4. Clean up the codebase: remove debug code, dead files and hard-coded paths.

YOU MUST HAVE
- Your own Windows PC with desktop Microsoft 365 Excel. This is essential: all testing happens in real Excel.
- Strong Python, and solid Excel VBA: .xlam add-ins, ribbon XML, events, COM.
- Hands-on experience with xlwings or win32com, and with writing to Excel in bulk, not cell by cell.
- The discipline to test your own work

• Craft a brief animatic or motion sample in Runway, After Effects, or a similar tool, layering atmospheric SFX and music (original or AI-generated is fine) that hints at the psychological stakes without revealing every twist.

1. A concise treatment (2–3 pages) that sells the suspense and emotional hook in Telugu but includes an English synopsis for wider pitching.

title: Online Content Removal Expert
desc:
Someone has uploaded photos and videos of me without my permission and they have spread across major social-media platforms, popular video-sharing sites, and now even appear in search-engine results. I need a specialist who can move quickly, file the right takedown notices, and follow through until every visible copy is gone.

The work involves:  
• Identifying every public instance of the content across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Vimeo, Reddit, Google Images, web caches, and any mirrors that surface during the process.  
• Drafting and submitting DMCA or privacy-based removal requests, escalating where necessary, and keeping a clear record of each submission, reference ID, and response.  
• Pushing removals through Google’s “Remove Outdated Content” and “Legal Removal” tools so the items disappear from search listings once they come down at the source.  
• Monitoring for re-uploads for a short period after completion and filing immediate notices if anything reappears.

This is an ASAP job, so I’m expecting someone who already knows each platform’s exact requirements, time frames, and escalation contacts. I’ll consider the project finished when you provide a final tracker that shows every link has either been deleted or fully de-indexed.

title: Monorail Feasibility Study Consultant
desc:
I am moving forward with a proposed monorail in Malaysia that will link key tourist and business districts. A single alignment and its stations have already been shortlisted, so the assignment now is to prove—on paper and in numbers—that this route is worth building.

Your mandate is to produce a bankable feasibility study that I can submit to government agencies, potential lenders and private investors. The focus is not on detailed engineering drawings; instead it is on demonstrating commercial, economic and operational viability from an independent perspective that blends both engineering practicality and financial realism.

Scope of the study  
• Demand & route validation – test the ridership potential on the preferred alignment, confirm station catchments and evaluate any minor route refinements that could boost demand.  
• Costs, funding and financial returns – develop capital and O&M cost estimates, model funding structures (public funding, PPP, concessions, etc.) and present NPV/IRR, payback and sensitivity analyses.  
• Economic advantage & wider benefits – quantify job creation, tourism uplift, time savings, land‐value gains and overall cost-benefit ratio in line with Malaysian appraisal guidelines.

Deliverables  
1. Full feasibility report (PDF) with an executive summary and clear go/no-go recommendation.  
2. Editable demand model and financial model (Excel or similar).  
3. Slide deck highlighting key findings for stakeholder presentations.

Acceptance criteria

title: Roll Forming Simulation & Roller Optimization -- 2
desc:
I need a detailed roll-forming simulation focused on optimizing the roller design and the entire set of forming passes for a steel or stainless-steel strip. You will receive the exact thickness, and material grade from me at the start of the project so the material model in your FEA setup is accurate.

Scope  
– Build and run the full forming simulation (e.g., using COPRA FEA RF, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, or a comparable package).  
– Iterate the flower pattern and roller geometries until the final profile exits within tolerance and free of cracking, wrinkling, and excessive springback.  
– Recommend any changes in pass sequence, roller radius, or alignment that lower forming loads or improve dimensional stability.

Deliverables  
• Simulation files and editable CAD of the optimized roller set  
• A concise report summarising stresses, thickness distribution, springback prediction, and the rationale behind each design change  
• PDF/DXF of the updated flower diagram ready for tooling manufacture

Please confirm the software you intend to use and an estimated turnaround time when you reply.

• One SEO-optimised title (≤ 200 characters) and backend term set (≤ 249 bytes).  
• Five conversion-focused bullet points and a refreshed description delivered in both styled HTML and plain text, ready for upload.  

After delivery, I’ll upload the content and monitor the ranking shifts; timely tweaks based on early data m

title: Online Survey Data Collection
desc:

Your role involves:
• Sending personalised survey invitations and two polite reminders within the agreed timeline.
• Monitoring response rates in real-time and flagging bounce-backs or opt-outs.
• Exporting the raw responses to Excel or CSV, then performing a basic completeness check (no missing mandatory fields, consistent scales).
• Summarising key metrics—total invitations, opens, clicks, and completed surveys—in a brief progress report each week.

Acceptance criteria
• Minimum 35 % completion rate from the provided list.
• Final dataset delivered as a clean CSV plus a short slide deck (Google Slides or PowerPoint) highlighting response counts and any noteworthy respondent comments.

All communication tools (Mailchimp, HubSpot, or a simple mail-merge in Gmail) are acceptable as long as tracking codes remain intact. Access to our Google Workspace will be granted after an NDA is signed.

Because participants often switch languages—English, Spanish, French, and sometimes others—you must be comfortable understanding and writing in several languages. You can lean on tools like Zoom or Teams live captions, Otter.ai, Notion AI, or similar, yet the final text must be polished, well-structured, and free of machine-translation quirks.

I usually schedule 30- to 60-minute meetings and would like the finished summary delivered within two hours of the session’s end, shared as a Google Doc (PDF backup appreciated). Consistency matters: clear headings, bullet-pointed actions, and correct spelling of every name.

If you have proven experience taking multilingual notes for both virtual and in-person meetings and can join calls across time zones, I’m ready to collaborate.

desc:

What I need is a native-level writer who can step in, keep the core information intact, and rewrite each script so it sounds 100 % human: casual, friendly, and easy for the general public to absorb. Humor is welcome where it fits, but the main focus is a smooth, approachable tone a viewer would hear from a real person, not a bot.

Typical tasks per script:
• Read the AI draft (roughly 15 minutes script).  
• Rewrite into natural, idiomatic German while preserving key points, examples, and call-to-action lines.  
• Trim or expand sentences as needed for better pacing and readability on screen.  
• Flag any factual oddities you spot; I’ll confirm or correct them quickly.

Deliverable:

I’ll start by sending one script so we can test chemistry and style. If it clicks, there’s a steady batch to follow.

desc:

• reconcile the figures against outward and inward supplies,  
• prepare the GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B in the government portal,  
• alert me to any mismatches or missing entries for prompt correction, and  
• share the working files or summaries you used so I can keep an internal audit trail.  

Accuracy and timeliness are critical—ideally the returns should be ready well before the statutory due dates. If you have a robust workflow for handling B2B invoices exported from Tally and can demonstrate that past filings have gone through without notices, I’d like to work with you on a month-to-month basis.

title: Monthly GST & TDS Filing

• Receive Tally data at the start of the month.  
• Reconcile figures, prepare GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and 26Q/24Q (or any other applicable) returns.  
• Submit for my review, e-file once approved, generate challans, and share acknowledgements plus a concise reconciliation note.

Acceptance criteria:  
• No mismatches between Tally ledgers and filed figures.  
• Returns filed at least three business days before due dates.  
• All challans, acknowledgements, and working papers delivered together.

If you work confidently with the GSTN portal, TRACES, and Tally, this can become a long-term monthly collaboration. Let me know your turnaround time and relevant experience, and we can begin with the upcoming cycle.

Once the reconciliation is clear, go ahead and complete the filing on the portal, generate the challan if tax is payable, and send me the acknowledgements. Tally, Busy, Zoho Books or similar tools are fine on your side as long as the final upload happens smoothly through the GST portal utilities.

title: Need Pano2VR Pro Expert for 360° Street View & GPS Auto-Linking Project (India)
desc:

3. Ensure no navigation arrows are broken or misaligned along the route.
4. Export the final structured CSV/Excel Image Index (containing Filename, Latitude, Longitude, Date, and Timestamp).
5. Generate Route Coverage GIS layers (KML/GPX tracks) from the project data.
6. Apply patches/blurring to public faces and private vehicle license plates for privacy compliance.
7. Deliver the output in standard HTML5 formats ready for cloud hosting (Amazon S3 / Google Cloud).
Requirements:
• Must have prior experience working with Pano2VR 7 Pro or Pano2VR 8 Pro.
• Must understand GPS metadata, Exif data integration, and auto-linking workflows.
• Must have a high-configuration workstation capable of processing thousands of 8K images smoothly.
• Communication language must be Hindi or fluent English.
Project Type: Long-term contract (Paid milestone-wise per 50 km patch delivered successfully).
